horizon_one.description: same randomized estimator with horizon 1 and anchor stride 2

no_moderation.description: randomized horizon estimator without loss-context moderation

random_policy.description: fit-identical estimator but randomized rather than learned assessment actions

anti_leakage: one Experience enters every observe call
no replay examples or gradient accumulation
no future labels enter the pre-action context
tune eligibility is decided before assessment effects
assessment restores only digest-bound tune snapshots
no post-hoc seed stream endpoint threshold or ablation changes

assessment.action_rule: apply anchor update iff beta_0 + beta_1 * context_loss < 0

estimand.interpretation: positive tau means applying the anchor update lowers discounted future loss under the fixed continuation policy
estimand.name: conditional H-step causal excursion effect of one SGD anchor update
estimand.scope: randomized eligible anchor decisions only; not a global parameter-level causal claim

gate.adaptation: candidate adaptation lag <= reference in every qualifying family and strictly lower in at least one qualifying delayed_reward or drift family
gate.family_multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni over four primary family loss tests
gate.loss: candidate family mean loss < reference with Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05
gate.mechanism: candidate mean loss < horizon_one and random_policy in at least one qualifying family
gate.required_temporal_family: at least one of delayed_reward or drift

resources.active_synaptic_ops: candidate <= 0.95 * reference in each qualifying family
resources.updates: candidate <= reference in each qualifying family

resource_accounting.active_operations: count every parameter update and estimator multiply-add
resource_accounting.event_count: sum declared event indices for every consumed Experience
resource_accounting.storage: weights, bias, four estimator coefficients, and four pending-window scalars
resource_accounting.update_count: count only applied model updates; skipped anchor actions count as zero

splits.fit: first third; randomized anchors and estimator updates
splits.tune: middle third; randomized anchors, frozen estimator, eligibility checks only

stop_rules: reject before implementation if independent protocol review is not accepted
stop before assessment if tune lock validation fails
close V3 as NoCandidate if the synthetic strict gate fails
do not run real streams unless synthetic status is candidate and an independent execution review authorizes it
close V3 as NoCandidate if the real strict gate fails
do not retune V3 after assessment effects
never reopen or retune the plasticity guard

treatment.action_0: skip the SGD update at the eligible anchor
treatment.action_1: apply the fixed-rate SGD update at the eligible anchor
treatment.assignment: stateless SHA-256(seed,stream,anchor_index) thresholded at propensity during fit and tune
treatment.continuation: apply fixed-rate SGD on each non-anchor item for both actions
